" 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking bail in Case Crime No.84 of 2021, under Sections 363, 376(3) and 506 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Bheeti, District Ambedkar Nagar.
3. This is inter faith matter.
Accused-applicant is a married man, aged around 40 years.

Allegation against the accused-applicant is of enticing away the prosecutrix,
aged abound 14 years, and then raping her.
4.

Considering the heinousness of offence, age of the accused-applicant, his marital status and the age of the victim, this Court does not find any ground to enlarge the accused-applicant on bail at this stage.
5. Bail application is accordingly rejected.
6. However, the trial court is directed to expedite the trial proceedings and conclude the same within a period of six months."
This Court while rejecting the first bail application of the accused-applicant, directed the trial court concerned to conclude the trial proceedings within a period of six months.

Trial court has progressed well, most of the witnesses of fact have been examined and even the six months have not passed and the present second bail application has been filed by the accused-applicant.
Thus, there is no change circumstance and no new ground which warrants this Court to enlarge/release the accused-applicant on bail at this stage.
In view of the above, the present second bail application of the accused-applicant is hereby rejected.
